label: Pulse Dot
author: conky-studio
description: A dot that pulses (grows/fades) continuously while Active is truthy, and sits dim/static otherwise -- wire a Threshold Gate, Playback Status via a comparison, or any 0/1-ish signal into Active for a 'something is happening' indicator.

properties.label: Active
properties.help: Truthy (>= 0.5) pulses; otherwise the dot sits dim and static.

lua_draw_body:
local r, g, b = {color}
 local active = ({active}) >= 0.5
 local t = wall_clock() * {speed}
 local phase = active and (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi)) or 0.15
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, 0.35 + 0.65 * phase)
 cairo_arc(cr, {x}, {y}, {radius} * (0.75 + 0.25 * phase), 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
